cases.name: initializer_integer_overflow
cases.note: Interpreter safety contract requires static rejection of an overflowing constant initializer. GNU folds this expression to INT_MIN even under strict standard flags, so no compiler-rejection oracle is claimed.

cases.name: unsupported_intrinsic_identifier
cases.note: Intrinsic names can be ordinary variable names in Fortran; this prototype explicitly reserves its intrinsic allowlist.
